ruleName: Threat Essentials - Multiple admin membership removals from newly created admin.
customDetectionName: Threat Essentials - Multiple admin membership removals from newly created admin.
hypothesis: A newly assigned Global Administrator subsequently removes two other Global Administrators within the one-hour removal window.

reasons: Every decisive AR/CD predicate was modeled manually.
The shared payload was validated against checked-in table metadata.

decisivePredicates: The assignment record is within seven days and precedes both removal records
The assignment is a successful Global Administrator assignment
The assigned target UPN equals the remover Initiator UPN
Both removal records are within one hour
Both removals resolve Role.DisplayName oldValue to Global Administrator
The remover is not MS-PIM or MS-PIM-Fairfax
The two removed target UPNs are distinct so array_length(TargetAdmins) > 1

limitations: Synthetic payload only; no Azure ingestion or detection execution was performed.
Timestamps must be refreshed consistently before any future time-windowed test.
